sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def brief():
    out = {}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c'): continue
        b = n['boundary']
        rs = [p[0] for p in b]; cs = [p[1] for p in b]
        out[n['color']+'@'+str(n['id'])] = (n['pixels'], (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
def block_state(s):
    # find 50px purple and white nodes in block area rows 34-43
    res = {}
    for k,(px,bb) in s.items():
        if px==50 and 30<=bb[0]<=45 and 25<=bb[2]<=40:
            res[k]=bb
    return res
s = brief()
print("start block:", block_state(s))
action(['SPACE'])
s = brief()
print("after SPACE1:", block_state(s), "brush:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if v[0]>=80})
r = last_action_result
if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'): print("STOP: level done"); 
action(['RIGHT','UP'])
s = brief()
print("after RIGHT,UP:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if v[0]>=80})
action(['UP','LEFT'])
s = brief()
print("after UP,LEFT:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if v[0]>=80})
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':37}])
s = brief()
print("after mouse white:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if v[0]>=80}, "swatches:", {k:v for k,v in s.items() if k.startswith(('w@','p@')) and v[1][0]<10})
action(['SPACE'])
s = brief()
print("after SPACE2:", block_state(s))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
